text:
incident-bot: [AUTO-PAGE] SEV2: multigpu collective failures in eu-prod-gpu-2. Symptoms: repeated NCCL timeouts (rendezvous stalls), containers restarting with CUDA Xid errors. Affected capacity: ~4 TP/PP training jobs and 6 inference shards. Paging oncall @ryan-oncall and #incidents for live mitigation.
ryan-oncall: I'm on it. Linking the pager bridge now — joining call in 2m. Anyone seen an obvious metric spike? :eyes:
emily-sre: CPU on the nodes looks normal, but network retransmits on eth0 jumped ~3x on node gpu-eu-12. NVPeer2 stats show transient link errors. I see container restarts with exit code 137 and kernel Xid 79 in dmesg.
devin-runtime: grabbing logs for the runtime. Which deployments/jobs IDs? provide job ids pls.
lucas-ml: Affected jobs: tp_job_1287 (tp=2, pp=4, batch=8), infer-embedder-03 (sharded). Both use NCCL-based allreduce. We pushed a GC change ~3hrs ago that increased transient memory usage.
ana-cs: Customer impact: two enterprise customers (acme-corp, acme-analytics) report increased latency and failed inferences. Support ticket numbers 9872, 9873. CS pointed out failures started ~09:03 UTC.
ryan-oncall: thanks. emily, can you paste the dmesg snippet? We need root cause clues.
emily-sre: pasted below:
```
[  +0.000000] Xid (PCIe) : 79
[  +0.000002] NVRM: GPU 0: Xid 79: Nov 10 12:03:45.123: GPU access fault
[  +0.000003] docker-containerd: killing container sha256:... due to oom
```
devin-runtime: also seeing repeated ncclCommInitRank timeouts in the runtime logs. Sample:
```
E 2026-03-17T09:04:02.321Z runtime: nccl: Timeout waiting for peers during rendezvous (commId=0x7f8b2c)
W 2026-03-17T09:04:02.322Z runtime: falling back to single-gpu in-flight for job tp_job_1287
```
ops-bot: automated action recommended: cordon gpu-eu-12, drain pods, and failover traffic to eu-prod-gpu-1/3. Would you like me to run the commands? (confirm with :thumbsup:)
ryan-oncall: please cordon and drain gpu-eu-12. Also start redirecting new inference requests to dedicated pool eu-dedicated-low-latency.
emily-sre: cordon+drain executed: `kubectl cordon gpu-eu-12 && kubectl drain gpu-eu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — pods rescheduled. Node shows NIC reset events; ENG infra requested a soft reboot.
lucas-ml: to reduce OOM pressure, can we reduce batch size on tp_job_1287 to 4 and restart that job gracefully? It was previously bumped to 8 during a throughput test.
devin-runtime: applying runtime mitigation: enabling NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR=1 for the runtime sidecar to force faster failover, and toggling PREFETCH_CACHE=1 to reduce KV cache churn. Restarting runtime sidecars for affected pods.
ana-cs: updating customers: letting them know we're actively mitigating, moving traffic to dedicated pool and will follow up with root cause. ETA for full recovery?
ryan-oncall: ETA ~20-30m for full job restarts and customer traffic normalization. Will keep updates every 10m. Creating incident bridge notes and tagging security if needed.
emily-sre: ops performed a soft reboot of gpu-eu-12 (reboot completed). NVLink counters reset, no further link errors after reboot so far. Node is back in cluster but we kept it cordoned until next verification.
devin-runtime: restarted tp_job_1287 with batch=4 and pp reduced. Allreduce now completes; ncclCommInitRank no longer timing out for that job. infer-embedder shards moved to eu-dedicated-low-latency pool, 0/6 failures now.
lucas-ml: confirming model quality unaffected by batch reduction; small throughput hit but acceptable for customers.
nana-cs: customers acknowledged the update and report degraded but usable service. Tickets updated to status: mitigated.
ryan-oncall: summary: triggered by transient NIC/NVLink errors on gpu-eu-12 causing NCCL rendezvous stalls, leading to OOM/container restarts for some TP/PP workloads. Mitigations: cordon + drain node, soft reboot, runtime sidecar flags to speed failover, reduced batch size for heavy TP job, rerouted inference to dedicated pool. Next steps: SRE to run hardware diagnostics on gpu-eu-12, Runtime to add graceful backoff for rendezvous retries, ML to add preflight mem checks for batch changes. I'll file a postmortem template and assign owners. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: incident ticket created: INC-2026-314. Postmortem draft link: https://rwd/pm/INC-2026-314
ryan-oncall: thx team. we'll keep the node cordoned until SRE signs off. closing live coordination thread, follow-up in #postmortems.
